subject: gov.policy
name: Agence Centrafricaine de Développement du Digital (ACDD)
milestone: Created by Loi 23.008 of 19 June 2023
position_end: A public industrial and commercial establishment created by law in June 2023, with a mandate to implement the national digital strategy
note: the agency's own presentation; no budget, staffing or activity report is held

subject: gov.policy
name: Ambition28 investment programme
milestone: Programme launched 4 September 2025
position_end: A US$12.8bn investment programme tied to the national development plan states an explicit national target of 3,000 km of fibre-optic deployment; no financing close, contract or kilometre built under it is recorded

subject: gov.policy
name: Government digitalisation roadmap
status: In development, finalised and adoption not recorded
milestone: Digital government strategy and 2026-2030 roadmap reported finalised, July 2026
position_end: The digital ministry reports the digital government strategy finalised, built on a national diagnostic of digital maturity and an inventory of public services, with a 2026-2030 roadmap, a governance architecture and a priority list of services to digitise; no adoption instrument or published text is held

subject: gov.policy
name: Government-wide cloud strategy
milestone: Recorded as not developed against a 2026 target
position_end: A development bank supervision report records the indicator for a government-wide cloud strategy developed and disseminated as not met at baseline, current or actual value, against a target of yes by 31 December 2026; nothing later records it being drafted

subject: gov.policy
name: National civil status policy
milestone: Technically validated at a workshop in Bangui, 23-25 April 2024
position_start: Not previously held by this repository
position_end: A policy orientation document and detailed action plan for modernising civil registration, validated technically by more than 35 participants from ministries, town halls and institutions under the European Union-financed civil-status modernisation project; adoption by the government is not recorded

subject: gov.policy
name: National data governance strategy
status: In development, drafted and adoption not recorded
milestone: Reported available by the digital ministry, July 2026
position_end: The digital ministry's July 2026 progress page for the digital governance project reports a national data governance strategy available, defining the institutional framework and recommending secure data sharing between administrations; no adoption instrument or text is held

subject: gov.policy
name: National data-hosting strategy
status: In development, on a participant's account
milestone: Strategy workshop held by the digital governance project, 2026-05-19
position_end: The public sector digital governance project held a workshop on 19 May 2026 on the technical and institutional framework for digital governance and the elaboration of a national data-hosting strategy, after the World Bank recruited consultants in 2024 to review public data-hosting infrastructure and recommend its modernisation
note: no draft or adoption is recorded

subject: gov.policy
name: National development plan 2024-2028
milestone: The governing framework since 2024, with an investors' round table in September 2025
position_start: In force as the frame for the digital agenda
position_end: Unchanged; cited as the frame for a ministry platform launch in February 2026
note: the round-table mobilisation total is stated by the ministry in a source that reads as a rewritten press release and is not independently corroborated

subject: gov.policy
name: Plan National Stratégique Centrafrique Digitale 2025
status: In development, studies validated and no adopting act held
milestone: Studies presented November 2021; recorded as validated at the backbone project's closure
position_start: Studies validated, no adopting act held
position_end: Commissioned in 2018 under the regional backbone grant and its studies presented in November 2021, with a national digital identity system alongside; the financier's completion report records the strategy studies as validated, and no adopting act is held for a plan whose horizon was 2025

subject: gov.policy
name: Public finances digitalisation plan 2025-2027
milestone: World Bank public finance review of 2 July 2026 puts tax digitisation at the centre of its revenue roadmap
position_start: Presented naming an electronic tax platform, a treasury system, procurement and payroll systems, a Tier IV data centre and a data governance policy, none of them priced
position_end: The costed operational plan is still unpublished; the World Bank's public finance review of 2 July 2026 estimates that digitising the tax administration could raise up to two points of GDP in additional revenue in the short term, and recommends electronic public procurement and a digital cadastre over the longer term, against domestic revenue of about FCFA 187bn or 10.1% of GDP in a 2025 budget of about FCFA 385bn
note: the named data governance policy is the only such instrument on file and no text, date or status for it is held; the review is the first independent assessment of the plan's subject matter the repository holds

subject: gov.policy
name: Universal service fund
milestone: Effective implementation named among the regulator's 2026 priorities at its draft-budget session
position_start: The levy provided for by a 2018 law and a February 2019 decree; the supervising committee's activities launched July 2025 and the fund not operational
position_end: Still not operational, with effective implementation targeted for 2026
note: the fund has never published an amount collected, a balance or an allocation in the seven years since the levy took effect

subject: gov.legislate
name: Access-to-information law
status: Not held, no such statute has been adopted
milestone: Absence stated by UNESCO for the 45th Universal Periodic Review
position_end: UNESCO's filing for the 45th periodic review states that no freedom-of-information law has been adopted, beside a 2020 communication law

subject: gov.legislate
name: Cybersecurity and cybercrime law
milestone: Voted by acclamation 2024-01-25, with promulgation reported as imminent
position_start: In force from early 2024, carrying six to ten year sentences and fines of FCFA 5m to 10m
position_end: Unchanged in text; named by a commentator in July 2026 as the instrument now used against online content
note: the statute's own text is not held and is a standing acquisition target; the 2026 source is an opinion column, not a record of prosecutions

subject: gov.legislate
name: Electronic communications law (Loi 18.002)
milestone: Promulgated 17 January 2018
position_end: A 157-article law governing electronic communications, repealing the 2007 telecommunications laws and levying 2% of operator revenue for universal service

subject: gov.legislate
name: Legal reform for digital transformation
milestone: Terms of reference issued under the digital governance project
position_end: Government terms of reference for legal reform covering personal data, cybersecurity, electronic communications and civil status with digital identification; two of the instruments they scope - the data protection law and the cybersecurity law - were made in early 2024, and nothing records the identification leg being drafted

subject: gov.legislate
name: Loi 22.002 on electronic transactions
milestone: Adopted 11 January 2022
position_end: The operative national law governing electronic transactions, and the single instrument the repository holds on that subject; the regulator's own law index carries it and the legal-reform terms of reference corroborate it
note: The law's own held record carries no resolvable address - the regulator's hosted file 404'd from two clients - so the claim cell links to the regulator's law index, which carries the citation, and the text itself is the second source.

subject: gov.legislate
name: Public procurement code
milestone: Adopted by acclamation 2025-12-11, replacing a 2008 law
position_start: The 2008 law governing, seventeen years in force and criticised in the explanatory memorandum for transparency, competition and control gaps
position_end: A new code with a FCFA 10,000,000 publicity threshold, a 5% preference margin for national and regional firms, a FCFA 2,500,000,000 small-business participation threshold and an eight-working-day formal notice
note: promulgation is not recorded and the enacted text is not held

subject: gov.legislate
name: Statistics law and its replacement
milestone: Draft law through technical validation and strategic review, awaiting the commission on draft official texts, reported 2026-10-10
position_start: The founding law of 16 July 2001 establishing the national statistical system, the statistics institute and the national statistics council, still the institute's own cited legal basis
position_end: A multi-stakeholder workshop with the presidency, the national assembly, ministries, the central bank and civil society validated a modernised draft law to replace it, carrying new institutional arrangements; the institute reported in October 2026 that the draft had passed technical validation and strategic review and awaited the commission that examines draft official texts; no adoption or promulgation is recorded

subject: gov.legislate
name: Tax of 1% on digital transactions (finance law 2024)
milestone: Operator fee rise in anticipation of it ordered reversed, 2024-04-15
position_end: The 2024 finance law introduced a tax of 1% on all digital transactions; in April 2024 the digital economy minister ordered Orange to reverse a mobile-money fee rise it had applied in anticipation, any tariff change needing the regulator's approval; how the tax is collected is not recorded

subject: gov.protect
name: Constitutional right to privacy
milestone: Constitution promulgated 30 August 2023 after the July referendum
position_end: The current constitution's article 31 establishes a right to respect for private life - the founding legal basis beneath the 2024 data protection law

subject: gov.protect
name: Data protection authority
milestone: A twelve-month statutory deadline expired in January 2025 with no establishment recorded
position_start: Not established, with the statute vesting its functions in the supervising ministry meanwhile
position_end: Not established, eighteen months past the statutory deadline
note: the sanction ceiling the unfilled body would wield is 5% of the last closed year's pre-tax turnover

subject: gov.protect
name: Loi n. 24.001 on personal data protection
milestone: Promulgated January 2024; no implementing decree found
position_start: In force since January 2024, a comprehensive regime with no supervisory authority and no implementing decree
position_end: Unchanged; the law in force and still no implementing decree on file
note: the held text is a scan with a poor character layer, so wording is legible and individual characters are not reliable

subject: gov.protect
name: National cybersecurity strategy, response team and operations centre
note: the only evidence is a 2022 appraisal recording that the country had none of the three and scored 3.6 on a cybersecurity index against 29.5 for the region; the one later account, a memorandum reported in September 2026, provides for a response team and an operations centre and records neither as built

subject: gov.protect
name: Tracing of citizens through mobile operators' SIM records
milestone: Reported 2026-08-31
position_end: the president turning to mobile operators to trace citizens through SIM card records, on a critical account
note: the account is a critical outlet's; no official instrument authorising the tracing is held

subject: gov.regional
name: CEMAC free movement on biometric identity documents
milestone: Police circular of 2024-09-23 applying the rules at every border post
position_end: Community citizens admitted for stays of up to 90 days on a valid biometric national identity card, CEMAC identity card, biometric passport or approved CEMAC passport, implementing the additional act of 1 April 2019 on common migration policy
note: Cameroon issued equivalent instructions on 18 September 2024

subject: gov.regional
name: CEMAC interoperable QR-code standard
milestone: Launched by the regional central bank and the payments body at Douala under an April 2026 regulation
position_end: A community standard binding across the six member states, routed and settled through the regional switch and secured to card-industry standards
note: the country's share of regional payment volume was 0.43% in 2024 and no country-specific adoption step is on file

subject: gov.regional
name: CEMAC Regional Financial Inclusion Strategy 2025-2029
milestone: Validated by the monetary union's ministerial committee 21 December 2023
position_end: A 2025-2029 regional strategy adopted by the central bank for the six member states, validated by the monetary union's ministerial committee on 21 December 2023 and published in February 2025; the 83-page text is held in full
note: the strategy is regional and the repository holds no member-state implementation plan, target or outturn under it

subject: gov.regional
name: Cross-border personal data transfer regime
milestone: Chapter III of the data protection law of 25 January 2024
position_end: The data protection law's chapter III sets the operative cross-border transfer regime on an adequacy basis; no adequacy decision, transfer authorisation or enforcement under it is on the record

subject: gov.regional
name: Regional digital integration programme accession
milestone: The minister met a development-bank delegation on the country's participation; no financing agreement recorded
position_end: Talks held on joining the six-country programme; no financing agreement, amount or date on file
note: a secondary aggregator with quotes attributed to a wire service; the meeting date is not stated

subject: gov.regional
name: Smart Africa Alliance membership
milestone: Welcomed as a recently joined member at the 8th ministerial council, 2026-03-24
position_end: A member, one of six recently joined states that took the alliance to 42; no national focal point, project or contribution is recorded

subject: gov.standards
name: Adoption of international statistical standards
milestone: Diagnostic against 19 international quality principles, May 2026
position_start: The enhanced general data dissemination standard implemented through a national summary data page
position_end: A restricted workshop in May 2026 finalised a diagnostic against 19 international statistical quality principles, feeding a future national quality assurance framework; a national data management, processing and dissemination policy governing quality standards and sharing mechanisms was validated in March 2026

subject: gov.standards
name: Regulator spectrum-monitoring and quality-of-service systems
milestone: A spectrum contract signed 2024-10-06 and completed 2025-06-19; a quality-of-service package signed 2024-10-15 with no completion date printed
position_start: The spectrum system delivered June 2025 and the second package under contract
position_end: Unchanged at the February 2026 revision of the procurement plan
note: the plan's actual-amount column is unpopulated throughout, so no contract value is published and the estimates must not be quoted as prices paid

subject: gov.standards
name: Suspension of non-homologated satellite kits
milestone: ARCEP began a field enforcement sweep in Bangui on 2026-08-12, ordered by the digital economy ministry
position_start: Did not exist: the service had not launched commercially and the wiki held no rule on satellite access
position_end: Roaming deactivated on kits acquired abroad that had not met homologation conditions, and from 12 August 2026 an ARCEP control operation across Bangui neighbourhoods - Damala, Benz-Vi, Miskine and the Don Bosco and Marabena roundabouts - identifying unregistered internet-access points; the ministry estimates about 3,000 Starlink users in the country against 200 registered with the regulator, and says the operation will extend progressively to provincial cities
note: the ratio is the ministry's own estimate and no register total is published; two of the operators visited said they had not been told registration was required

subject: gov.discourse
name: Government spokesperson's communication-monitoring cell (CVC-PG)
milestone: Created by presidential decree, reported 2026-09-17
position_end: A cell under the government spokesperson with a permanent secretariat and three units, one of them dedicated to crisis communication and countering rumours through monitoring of broadcast, print, online media and social networks; staff are appointed by decree in Council of Ministers, and no budget or start of operations is on record

subject: gov.discourse
name: Regulator request for tighter identification and platform account closures
milestone: A press conference by the communications council's president with requests to the regulator and the justice ministry
position_end: Requests for better control of subscriber identification to limit anonymous accounts, activation of international judicial cooperation against content produced abroad, and cooperation with international platforms on reporting and closing accounts; no instrument adopted
note: the council acknowledged that its own competence covers media professionals

subject: finance.budget
name: Administration telephone arrears to the incumbent operator
milestone: Carried unchanged at FCFA 250m in the 2026 framework
position_start: FCFA 250,000,000 in the 2025 estimates, from FCFA 100,000,000 in 2024
position_end: FCFA 250,000,000 in the 2026 estimates
note: the state budgets the same arrears to its own incumbent for a third year while negotiating that operator's privatisation

subject: finance.budget
name: Budget outturn at any grain
note: a complete quarterly execution series is published on time and every issue is a page-image scan whose digits do not extract; availability is not the constraint, extraction is, and settled accounts run only to 2019

subject: finance.budget
name: Customs system deployment
milestone: A single 2026 activity for deployment to third-terminal sites
position_start: Two lines together worth FCFA 245,000,000 in 2025
position_end: FCFA 420,000,000 for 2026 in a single deployment line
note: the largest single 2026 digital line outside the digital ministry's vote, and it is customs revenue collection

subject: finance.budget
name: Digital development agency transfer
milestone: Split in the 2026 framework into an urban fibre-loop activity and a salary-arrears activity
position_start: FCFA 200,000,000 proposed in 2025 and raised to FCFA 300,000,000 in the mid-year revision, from FCFA 50,000,000 in 2024
position_end: FCFA 300,000,000 for urban optical loops plus FCFA 118,000,000 to clear six months of unpaid 2024 salaries, FCFA 418,000,000 in total
note: the agency's transfer has risen roughly eightfold in two years, and a quarter of the 2026 figure is arrears on its own staff's pay

subject: finance.budget
name: Enacted appropriation for any year
note: every figure held is proposed or revised; all three enacted finance laws are image-only scans, so whether the Assembly amended the digital vote between draft and vote is not established

subject: finance.budget
name: Private-invoice transfers in the digital ministry vote
milestone: Two named private-invoice lines carried in the 2026 medium-term framework
position_start: One line at FCFA 500,000,000 proposed in 2025 and raised to FCFA 800,000,000 in the mid-year revision, with no second line in 2024 or 2025
position_end: FCFA 1,000,000,000 and FCFA 500,000,000 for the two lines in 2026, the first doubled in a year and quadrupled in two
note: scope unclear: the estimates state no purpose for either payment in any year, and together they are 21 times the digital ministry's entire investment title

subject: finance.budget
name: Regulator support transfer
milestone: Carried at FCFA 1.6bn in the 2026 medium-term framework
position_start: FCFA 1,400,000,000 in the 2025 estimates, from FCFA 1,300,000,000 in 2024
position_end: FCFA 1,600,000,000 in the 2026 estimates, up 14.3%
note: partial scope, because the regulator covers post as well as electronic communications

subject: finance.budget
name: Regulator's own draft budget
milestone: A draft budget presented to the board at its 2026-04-15 session
note: the first regulator budget figure the wiki has obtained; on this pair the fisc funds roughly a quarter of the regulator in both years, which is a level rather than a change

subject: finance.budget
name: State budget
milestone: Finance law n°25.015 posted 2025-12-29
movement: Advanced on own revenue, Regressed on deficit
position_start: A mid-year 2025 revision with resources of FCFA 367.20bn, own resources FCFA 186bn and a deficit of FCFA 17.18bn
position_end: For 2026: resources FCFA 368bn, expenditure FCFA 396.35bn, a deficit of FCFA 28bn to be raised on the sub-regional market, own resources FCFA 206.80bn up 11.18%, and public investment down 2.06%; the enacted law, n°25.015, was posted by the finance ministry on 29 December 2025 as an image-only scan
note: finance laws are repeatedly filed after the statutory September deadline with no formal reaction from the Assembly

subject: finance.mou
name: Dormant data-centre memorandum
milestone: Signed January 2025 and never advanced to contract
position_start: A memorandum signed with no contract
position_end: Unchanged at 2026-07-20: still no contract, site or financing
note: one of five live proposals circling the same unbuilt national data centre, and a twelve-month absence of movement is the finding

subject: finance.mou
name: IFC digital financial services accords
milestone: Three accords signed 2025-11-10
position_end: An institutional accord with the finance ministry aligned to the IFC's 2030 strategy and the national development plan, one with a commercial bank on its participation in digital services, and one with the incumbent mobile operator on building the capacity of its distributor network
note: no commitment sum is stated for any of the three

subject: finance.mou
name: Memorandum with AMINI on data, AI and security infrastructure
milestone: Signed by the internet and security unit, reported 2026-09-29
position_end: A cooperation memorandum between the national internet and security unit and a data-infrastructure and AI company, signed after the President met its founder at the UN General Assembly, providing for a national data centre, a security operations centre and a national computer emergency response team, digitised geological data and a digital twin of the subsoil for mining, and connectivity and skills transfer, with the state's technological sovereignty and data protection as stated aims
note: no cost, financing, site, timetable or data-hosting terms are published; it is a further proposal for a national data centre beside those already on this ledger

subject: finance.new
name: Central Africa digital integration programme component
milestone: National component to launch April 2027
position_end: The country's component of the regional Central Africa digital integration programme is to launch in April 2027, following a week of work in Bangui by a financier mission covering connectivity, public services, data and cybersecurity. No national allocation or workplan is published

subject: finance.new
name: Regional digital integration programme
milestone: The minister met a development-bank delegation; no amount, instrument or date committed
position_end: Talks reported on joining the six-country regional programme covering broadband, cross-border interconnection, secure public platforms and digital skills; no figure, signature or follow-up since
note: a secondary aggregator with quotes attributed to a wire service; treat participation as reported intent rather than finance

subject: infra.connect
name: Central African Internet Exchange
milestone: Creation recorded under highlights for January 2026 in a foreign operator's half-year report
position_end: A national internet exchange point created, described as reinforcing digital sovereignty; no membership, peering or traffic figure held
note: month precision, and the sole source is an operator's investor filing with no government instrument held

subject: infra.connect
name: Fourth-generation mobile licensing
milestone: A third operator launched 4G in Bangui, completing commercial service at all three
position_start: One operator live since May 2025 and a second licence renewed in January 2025; the third held no licence
position_end: All three hold licences, the third licensed in December 2025 and live in May 2026; a licence is not coverage, and 4G population coverage was measured at 0.3% in 2023
note: the launch source is a wire outlet and the operator's own release is not held

subject: infra.connect
name: Internet use rate
milestone: Regulator's first-half 2026 market observatory
movement: Advanced, on the regulator's own client count
position_start: An international estimate of 13.8% for 2024 and a publisher estimate of 15.5% in January 2025
position_end: 1.56 million internet clients, more than 23% of the population, and 3.9 million mobile clients at end-June 2026 on the regulator's count (2026-06); the earlier figure, about 670,000 users at 12.0% (October 2025), is a publisher's estimate of people rather than subscriptions
note: the regulator's count and the user estimates measure different things and are not compared

subject: infra.connect
name: National fibre backbone
milestone: Inauguration of the first sections of the backbone and the Congo interconnection
position_start: 935 km of terrestrial and sub-fluvial fibre in service on the Bangui-Douala corridor with spurs to Cameroon and Congo
position_end: Unchanged; no new kilometrage, commissioning or route added through 2026-08-06, while the 2026 estimates appropriate FCFA 2,000,000 to connect prefecture capitals to Bangui over it
note: the development bank is the announcer of record for 935 km; the minister's claim of about 1,200 km in July 2025 is unverified

subject: infra.connect
name: Passive infrastructure licence
milestone: The regulator signed the specification granting the country's first passive-infrastructure licence
position_start: A licence signed for pylons, antennas and technical sites to be built and leased to the mobile operators, with nothing built
position_end: Unchanged: no tower count, site build, operator lease or deployment record through 2026-08-06
note: granted fourteen days before the window opened, so the whole window is the silence after it

subject: infra.connect
name: Provincial mobile service outage
milestone: Subscribers at a northern town reported no calls, no internet and no mobile money for close to a month
position_start: Service in operation; the repository held nothing on this locality before
position_end: Voice, data and mobile money all down with no restoration date, and some officials unpaid for the previous month because salary transfers run over mobile services
note: single-operator dependency with no redundancy, attributed to off-grid relay sites, equipment theft and repair crews travelling hundreds of kilometres

subject: infra.connect
name: Regulator quality-of-service publication website
milestone: The minister stated the regulator had obtained financing for a site publishing operators' quality-of-service data
position_start: Did not exist; the regulator's domain served a placeholder page
position_end: Financing obtained; no site recorded as live on a third test at 2026-07-26
note: if delivered it would add a measure of service quality to the regulator's market counts

subject: infra.connect
name: Routes to submarine cable capacity beyond the current transit country
milestone: Ministers agreed in Moscow on 8 October 2026 on the need to carry out the DRC interconnection
position_end: a published assessment of the options for reaching submarine cable capacity other than through Cameroon; in October 2026 the digital-economy ministers of the two countries agreed on the need to carry out a fibre interconnection with the Democratic Republic of Congo, which the ministry says would reach the submarine cable landing at Moanda as a third international route, with no timetable or financing announced

subject: infra.connect
name: Satellite broadband service
status: Implemented, roaming deactivated on non-homologated kits
milestone: Counted in the regulator's observatory for the first time, first half of 2026
position_start: Did not exist: no licence and no service
position_end: Commercially live since 2026-03-16 as the operator's 27th African market, with 450 government kits; the monthly subscription is about 136% of monthly income per head; roaming on kits acquired abroad deactivated; at end-June 2026 the operator held more than 70% of 5,380 fixed-wireless internet clients and carried 22.89 million of the half's 36.11 million GB of internet traffic, on the regulator's count
note: the convention was brokered with United States embassy involvement; affordability rather than availability is the constraint

subject: infra.connect
name: Twelve-thousand-kilometre fibre commitment
milestone: Stated by the minister at the ministry's 2026 orientations ceremony
position_end: A commitment stated by the minister; no contract, financing, route, phasing or timetable is held and no progress in the six months since
note: the figure is roughly ten times the backbone built to date and reaches the wiki only through a ministerial speech

subject: infra.store
name: Electoral authority data-processing centre
milestone: Fire in the week before 24 September 2026; investigation opened
position_end: The national elections authority's data-processing centre was partly damaged by fire in the week before 24 September 2026, weeks ahead of the October 2026 residual elections; the government opened an investigation and says the elections will go ahead
note: no cause, damage estimate or continuity arrangement is stated

subject: infra.store
name: Government secure interconnection network
milestone: Included as the second axis of the vendor package presented at the May 2026 working meeting
position_end: A dedicated network of five microwave-relay sites interconnecting ministries; no contract, site list, financing or timetable held
note: a fourth axis, a secure radio network for the police, is carried only by one of the two accounts

subject: infra.store
name: Incumbent operator privatisation
milestone: The minister met the counterparty's operations vice-president, moving a September 2025 memorandum to an operational phase
position_start: Did not exist; the prior rescue, agreed in November 2020, needed EUR 20m before work could start
position_end: An operational phase declared, with definitive takeover agreements, a joint steering committee and a deployment schedule still to be established and the deal structure undisclosed
note: US$150m announced covering network modernisation, a data centre and a connectivity ecosystem; the fourth rescue attempt on this incumbent

subject: infra.store
name: National Tier III data centre
milestone: A vendor delegation met the ministry on a four-axis package whose first axis is a national Tier III data centre
position_start: No built national data centre; two ministry facilities recorded under construction in 2022 with no completion record, and a dormant 2025 memorandum
position_end: Still nothing built at 2026-07-20, with two further sponsors added as threads; no contract, site, award or commissioning record for any of them
note: the 2026 pitch repeats a 2022 target for the same facility; five threads and three sponsors, and nothing built

subject: infra.store
name: Regional data-centre programme
milestone: Project at definition stage, 25% progress
position_end: Six new data centres planned across the community including one in the Central African Republic, alongside the reinforcement of five existing centres elsewhere, at a stated total cost of US$9.00m across eleven countries
note: the prospectus states a programme total, not a country allocation

subject: infra.energy
name: Electricity access rate
milestone: A 2023 figure cited in reporting of 2026-03-06
position_start: 14.3% in 2022, about 35% in the capital and about 0.4% rural
position_end: 17% in 2023; nothing later held
note: the figure reaches the wiki through a secondary aggregator citing development-bank data

subject: infra.energy
name: Electricity supply for digital infrastructure
milestone: Solar plant reported in service, February 2025
position_start: No utility report, tariff schedule or commissioning record on file
position_end: A 25 MWp solar plant with 30 MWh of battery storage cutting dependence on diesel generation by 90% and raising domestic generation capacity by 40%, with prepaid metering installed for all non-essential public facilities and the national utility’s commercial systems revamped
note: the record is about national supply; no source ties generation to digital infrastructure specifically

subject: infra.energy
name: Generation capacity and grid restoration
milestone: Solar plant with storage inaugurated 12 August 2026
position_start: 28MW installed and 23MW available at appraisal with 16 to 18 hours of daily load-shedding and 33% distribution losses
position_end: A 50MW solar plant with 15MWh of battery storage was inaugurated in August 2026, reported to raise national generation capacity by over 60% and to strengthen grid stability - the most significant in-window movement on the power supply digital infrastructure depends on. One hydroelectric generating unit was repaired and returned to service in January 2026, restoring capacity critical to the capital

subject: infra.capacity
name: Government network under the digital governance project
milestone: 25 pilot ministries connected, reported July 2026
position_end: The digital ministry reports the government network launched with 25 pilot ministries connected, cabling works under way, the connectivity tender under evaluation and the active-equipment contract in negotiation, as at July 2026

subject: infra.capacity
name: Technical capacity, workforce and skills
milestone: Graduate bootcamp run at the national university, March 2026
position_end: A digital training centre and incubator in the capital, financed at EUR 17m by the European Union and EUR 13m by a development bank, has a stated capacity of 50 trainees. The regulator runs a digital monitoring platform at its headquarters with 80 terabytes of storage, launched in April 2024 - the only dated, quantified statement of an operational government technical capability the repository holds. A three-day professional project bootcamp for 17 recent graduates, 12 of them women, ran at the national university in March 2026
note: the index returns zero sources carrying this subject for the country at any date

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Cybersecurity and electronic-certification platform
milestone: Listed in the development bank's delivered scope at the backbone inauguration
position_start: Recorded as delivered in the funder's own release, with no operator, uptake or certificate-issuance record
position_end: Unchanged; nothing added through 2026-08-06 and no held source names the platform again
note: the only cybersecurity capability the wiki can point to as delivered rather than announced, and it has no operating record

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Loi 24.002 on cybersecurity and cybercrime
milestone: Made 21 February 2024
position_end: The country's cybersecurity and cybercrime statute, whose full article text is now held after the regulator's own hosted file failed to resolve; the regulator's law index is the second record of it

subject: infra.cybersec
name: National cybersecurity agency
milestone: The 2026 estimates and programme budget carry no line, allocation or institution for the agency, a third consecutive year
position_start: Created by a cybersecurity law voted by acclamation in January 2024 under joint supervision, to secure information systems, handle alerts and regulate the sector, with no establishment record
position_end: Unchanged; the agency appears nowhere in the 2024, 2025 or 2026 estimates under any wording
note: the search for the word cyber returns nothing across 602 pages of estimates and 183 pages of programme budget

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Network-security and digital-trust appropriations
milestone: The 2026 programme budget carries FCFA 4,000,000 for network and information-system security and FCFA 2,000,000 for digital trust
position_end: FCFA 6,000,000 combined for the year for the whole country, against FCFA 1,600,000,000 transferred from the same ministry to the regulator
note: 2026 is the country's first programme budget, so there is no comparable prior-year activity line

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Government interoperability or data-exchange layer
milestone: Platform launched at the planning ministry, February 2026
position_end: A national platform became operationally effective at the planning ministry - data migrated, staff use made mandatory and a launch ceremony held in late February 2026 - the first working government data platform the repository holds. Separately, the development-bank-financed digital governance project tendered a technical-assistance contract to map the public-finance systems and design their target architecture and interoperability in November 2025, listed as awarded in May 2026, so the architecture the platform would sit in is contracted and not yet designed
note: nothing on file: no exchange layer, interoperability framework, application interface or data-sharing standard; the minister's own January 2026 statement is that state information systems remain heterogeneous

subject: dpi.id
name: Biometric electoral register
milestone: The electoral authority published the definitive electoral list
position_start: The register under revision on the system used since the 2020 general elections, with 1,641,083 enrolled at the 2020 revision
position_end: A definitive list of 2,398,158 registered voters, 1,641,083 carried from 2020 plus 757,075 registered in 2025, used on 2025-12-28 across 3,910 voting centres
note: the authority's own provisional results state a turnout percentage computed on an electorate 5,212 lower than its definitive list

subject: dpi.id
name: Biometric passport issuance
milestone: Issuance resumed under a new operator
position_start: Issuance resumed with payment funnelled through only two banks, a bottleneck flagged by users' associations
position_end: Unchanged; no volume, price or coverage record held since
note: nothing dated inside the window, but it is the second document rail and its operator concentration is a live governance question

subject: dpi.id
name: Identification system diagnostic
milestone: Country diagnostic published 2017
position_end: The foundational identification diagnostic records that no functioning national digital identity authentication service existed, and names the country's largest digital database at the time; it remains the repository's only systematic account of the identification estate

subject: dpi.id
name: Mandatory unique identification number
milestone: Recorded as delivered in a budget-support completion report, June 2025
position_end: A development bank's completion report for a general budget-support operation records the unique identification number as made mandatory - the clearest statement the repository holds that one identifier is required across other systems; no coverage figure or consuming system is named

subject: dpi.id
name: National digital identity system
milestone: Announcement of the system and of a new identification office
position_end: Announced as a US$13m integrated ecosystem built around a unique identification number, managed by a new office, unifying existing biometric and civil-registration databases; the implementation window is 2027 to 2032 with assessments, procurement and an international tender still ahead
note: an announcement rather than delivery: no procurement, award or enrolment record is held, and the account reads as a project communiqué

subject: dpi.id
name: National identity card
status: Implemented, legal tariff restored and access priced informally
milestone: Reporting of religiously targeted extortion at enrolment counters, with the legal tariff formally unchanged
position_start: The legal price restored to FCFA 4,500 by interministerial order of June 2025 after five years of charging above it
position_end: The tariff holds on paper while at one prefecture police are reported to serve one religious group first and demand FCFA 100,000 to 200,000 from another, requiring the father's and grandfather's birth certificates
sources: 2026-06-16-cni-extortion-discrimination-ndele-corbeaunews|2025-07-27 Centrafrique - le prix des cartes d'identite reduit apres cinq ans de violations de la loi
note: the card is the gateway document for the electoral roll and most administrative access; the movement is in access and price, not technology

subject: dpi.pay
name: Active mobile-money clients
milestone: Regulator's first-half 2026 market observatory
position_end: More than 702,000 active mobile-money clients at end-June 2026, on the regulator's count from operators' returns
note: no transaction value or agent count is given alongside it

subject: dpi.pay
name: Automated mobile payment of the import declaration fee
milestone: Service launched July 2026
position_end: An operator, a customs technology supplier and a state entity launched automated mobile-money payment of the prior import declaration fee with automatic generation of the declaration reference - a business-to-government payment rail on the customs chain; no transaction volume or value is published

subject: dpi.pay
name: Electricity bill payment over mobile money
milestone: Official launch at Bangui 2026-08-04 under a contract dated October 2025
position_end: State electricity bills payable over one operator's mobile-money service, launched officially on 2026-08-04 for subscribers including those in Bambari, Berberati, Sibut, Bouar and Beloko; no tariff, transaction fee, volume, revenue share or exclusivity term disclosed
note: the two companies are the only announcers of record and no regulator is named; the report states subscribers were already paying this way before the ceremony, so the launch date is of the agreement rather than of first use

subject: dpi.pay
name: GIMACPAY regional switch
milestone: 91 participants across the six member states by 2021
position_end: Live across the six member states with 91 participants by 2021, settling on a deferred net basis at the regional central bank
note: A regional rail rather than a national one; no per-country participation figure is given

subject: dpi.pay
name: Gulf-state digital finance and land-banking memorandum
milestone: A memorandum signed at Bangui by the minister coordinating major works and strategic investments
position_end: Covering digital finance and land banking, presented as mobilising investment for infrastructure while modernising land administration; no commitment figure, disbursement schedule or governance arrangement stated
note: it couples a payments ambition and a land-registry ambition under one offshore private counterparty, and registers as intent rather than finance

subject: dpi.pay
name: Mobile money service points in interior localities (digital governance project)
milestone: Goods tender issued 2026-10-13, bids due 2026-11-13
position_start: Did not exist; about 15 mobile money agents per 100,000 adults, concentrated in Bangui (2023)
position_end: The digital governance project tendered, under World Bank grant IDA 9950-CF, the kits for setting up mobile money agents in localities outside the capital, at an estimated US$200,000, with bids due on 13 November 2026

subject: dpi.pay
name: Mobile-money impersonation fraud
milestone: Phishing campaign debunked by a community fact-checking network, July 2026
position_end: A community fact-checking network debunked a messaging-app phishing scam impersonating a mobile-money service with a fake prize contest harvesting phone numbers and personal identification codes. No regulator or operator statement, complaint count or remedy is held, so the consumer-protection response is a fact-check by a non-state body

subject: dpi.pay
name: Mobile-money salary payment for officials outside the capital
milestone: A month-long operator outage at a northern town left officials unpaid
position_start: 1,702 civil servants in regions without banking services paid by mobile money, recorded as a project achievement in May 2025
position_end: No later enrolment figure held, and at one town subscribers reported no calls, no internet and no mobile money for close to a month with prepaid bundles expiring unused
note: single-operator dependency with no redundancy

subject: dpi.pay
name: Payment platform for social-transfer beneficiaries
milestone: Expressions of interest requested, 3 March 2026
position_end: A procurement notice requested expressions of interest to design and operationalise a payment platform for social-safety-net beneficiaries; it is a feasibility and design step, with no supplier, cost or delivery date on the record

subject: dpi.pay
name: POST CASH national fintech platform
milestone: Specification consultancy tendered, proposals due 2026-10-25
position_end: UNDP is recruiting a consultant for 30 working days in Bangui to write the functional and technical specification of the national fintech platform POST CASH; no operator, budget or launch date is stated
note: the tender documents sit behind a login and are not held

subject: dpi.pay
name: Share of regional electronic-payment volume
milestone: The regional central bank's 2024 payment-services report published its per-country split
position_end: 0.43% of regional payment-operation volume in 2024, the smallest but one, against the largest member state's 65.10%
note: the report holds no value figure or account count for the country

subject: dpi.pay
name: Tranglo e-wallet payouts
milestone: Coverage extended to the country, July 2025
position_end: A cross-border payment hub added e-wallet payouts in the country, among five new African markets
note: the company's own release; no volume is published

subject: dpi.registry
name: Birth-registration project
milestone: A project launched across the region including the country
position_end: 3,000 birth certificates targeted in the country
sources: 2025-08-12 La Francophonie supports birth registration efforts across Central Africa, Madagascar
note: launched eleven days into the window with no progress, delivery or completion record since, and an order of magnitude smaller than the civil-status modernisation programme

subject: dpi.registry
name: Business register digitisation and territorial reach
milestone: Single-window website launched 12 May 2026
movement: Advanced, a website launched while creation stays largely manual
position_start: Registration handled from the capital, with a second branch at Bambari
position_end: The single window, running since 2007 with branches at Bambari and Berberati, launched a website on 12 May 2026 with World Bank support while company creation remained largely manual, remote creation being the stated aim; a specification to digitise the manual commercial register was validated in October 2025; the government credits it with 14,645 firms, against informality near 80%

subject: dpi.registry
name: Cadastre and land-registry digitisation
milestone: A Gulf-state memorandum adds land-administration modernisation to the stated programme
position_start: A US$1.6m agreement of April 2024 for a second phase of public-administration digitalisation including an electronic cadastre, and 1,700 hectares tokenised by presidential decree in June 2025
position_end: No cadastre system delivery record held; the 2026 medium-term framework carries FCFA 625,000 for updating the mining cadastre and FCFA 650,000 for a petroleum database
note: the two registry lines together are FCFA 1,275,000 for the year

subject: dpi.registry
name: Civil status modernisation project
milestone: Project document held
position_end: A project to support the modernisation of civil registration, held through its own project document
note: a project document rather than a delivery report; no registration coverage, office count or completion date is stated in what is held

subject: dpi.registry
name: Diagnostic of civil-registry archive holdings
milestone: National archiving expert recruited under a European project
position_end: A recruitment was opened for a national physical-archiving expert to diagnose civil-registry archive holdings across registry centres, courts, health facilities and justice bodies - the step before any digitisation of what those holdings contain

subject: dpi.registry
name: EU-UNICEF birth registration programme
milestone: Agreement signed 2025-08-14 for four years
position_end: A four-year programme to register at least 150,000 children, about 37,500 additional births a year, chiefly in Bangui, Bambari and Bouar, linking 135 health centres with 43 civil registry offices so births are registered where they happen

subject: dpi.registry
name: Late birth-registration campaign
milestone: Campaign launched in the capital prefecture, 29 January 2026
position_end: A campaign run by the territorial administration ministry with a European partner reports 61,000 additional registrations; it is late registration of people already born rather than registration at birth

subject: dpi.registry
name: Official denial of online land transactions
milestone: Ministry communique of 9 July 2026
position_end: The urban planning and land reform ministry denied publicly that land parcels could be bought through an online platform or by mobile money - strong evidence that no transactional digital land service exists, stated by the ministry that would run one

subject: dpi.registry
name: Postal addressing convention
milestone: Country addressing reference dated March 2022
position_end: The operative addressing convention is post-office-box based: the international postal reference records no street numbering, no postcode and no national physical address register

subject: dpi.registry
name: Social registry
milestone: Second additional financing approved, 28 May 2026
position_start: A social registry and a fully digitised payment system established as the foundations of a social-protection system by a closed project and transferred to the responsible ministry
position_end: The registry's development is financed by a safety-nets project appraised in May 2024, and a second additional financing of US$50m - taking emergency support to US$150m - was approved on 28 May 2026, scaling emergency cash transfers. No registered-household figure is published

subject: dpi.mis
name: ASYCUDA World customs system (SYDONIA World)
milestone: All computerised offices migrated, June 2023
position_end: Migrated from ASYCUDA++ with European Union funding from June 2022, piloted at Bangui airport in February 2023 and running at all computerised offices by June 2023, including the transit office in Douala, with transit data exchanged with Cameroon since; bank interconnection and the non-computerised offices were still in preparation

subject: dpi.mis
name: Civil-service payroll and human-resources system
milestone: A funder project paper recorded the payroll clean-up as a project achievement
position_start: A payroll clean-up removing more than 2,000 ghost workers, built by the national informatics office
position_end: Unchanged; no later headcount, payroll-value or coverage figure held
note: the only state management system on file with a delivered result, and nothing is dated inside the window

subject: dpi.mis
name: Customs transit interoperability and digital reporting
milestone: Regional customs interoperability mission, 21-30 April 2026
position_end: A neighbouring customs administration's mission assessed interoperability between its own platform and the customs system this country uses, and prepared implementation of the regional transit-tracking system; a European mission separately trained ten customs judicial police officers on digital drafting of customs reports under the national border management plan

subject: dpi.mis
name: Education management and human-resources systems
milestone: Completion report on the closed sector plan project, June 2026
position_end: A closed sector plan support project's completion report is the repository's clearest statement of where the education management and human-resources information systems stand, and a successor education project approved in June 2024 and effective in December 2024 carries a component on them, its operational start-up recorded in March 2025. Neither states a school count on the system or a data-collection cycle completed

subject: dpi.mis
name: Electronic cargo tracking note (BESC)
milestone: Launched in Douala 2023-05-30
position_end: An electronic cargo tracking note for the country's imports and exports, issued by a private operator, launched in Douala by the two countries' transport ministers alongside a ship-owner commission levy

subject: dpi.mis
name: Hospital telemedicine link
milestone: Reported in use at a remote hospital 2026-08-18
position_end: A remote hospital using telemedicine to reach a global network of healthcare professionals, run by an international medical organisation
note: an operator-run service at one site rather than a state system; no case volume, connectivity arrangement or continuity plan is published

subject: dpi.mis
name: Integrated criminal database
milestone: Established 9 October 2026 with UN mission and UNODC support
position_end: The country's first integrated criminal database, with the centre, equipment and servers financed by the UN mission and technical expertise, training and connectivity support from UNODC, to share information between police and gendarmerie and track crime trends; extension to the judicial police and the gendarmerie's investigations service, reliable backups and roll-out to the regions are the stated next steps

subject: dpi.mis
name: Justice sector policy and judicial statistics
milestone: Sector policy adopted 12 December 2019 for 2020 to 2024
position_end: The sector policy calls for developing judicial statistics collection and analysis and for computerisation; its term ran to 2024 and no successor, and no judicial statistic, is held. A provisional criminal database was installed at the judicial police directorate after criminal-records training in early 2022

subject: dpi.mis
name: National health information system on district software
milestone: Deployment across all 35 health districts documented, May 2026
position_end: The district health information software is deployed across all 35 health districts, documented in a community poster accepted for the software's 2026 annual conference. Vaccination microplanning was digitised into it for one health region across workshops in March 2026, producing per-facility microplans and interactive health-area maps, and an electronic medical record deployed with the health ministry and a foundation assigns each patient a unique identification on registration

subject: dpi.mis
name: Sector management information systems
milestone: Newborn-data functionality study published December 2025
position_start: No sector management information system on file
position_end: The health ministry runs DHIS2 as its routine health information system, a four-country study finding it offers users in the Central African Republic fewer functionalities than in the three comparators, with a US$70m World Bank and Global Financing Facility project supporting health service delivery and system strengthening since 2022
note: no education-sector system is on file, so this holds for health alone

subject: dpi.mis
name: Tax and customs digitalisation
milestone: First structured official evaluation report, May 2026
position_start: An online tax platform launched in 2023 with European funding, an automated value-added tax module and an electronic cadastre among the finance ministry's applications
position_end: The first structured official report evaluating the measures describes the tax platform alongside the customs system as the operative digitalisation. The finance ministry's own roadmap of March 2025 sets eight reform axes covering tax, procurement, integrated financial and human-resources management, and the fund's programme carries new structural benchmarks on platform use by large taxpayers. The fiscal risk statement accompanying the 2026 budget bill records tax-administration weaknesses among five risk categories to revenue mobilisation

subject: dpi.mis
name: Trade facilitation implementation, UN Global Survey
milestone: 2025 survey round
movement: No change, a first count with no earlier figure behind it
position_end: 70.97% overall implementation in the 2025 round, with paperless trade at 88.89% and cross-border paperless trade at 38.89%

subject: dpi.govtech
name: CNSS online social-security declaration platform
milestone: Opened to employers 2025-05-26
position_end: The social security fund opened its website and an online declaration platform for employers on 26 May 2025 under its strategic plan for 2024-2028; no count of employers filing online is published

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Electronic public procurement system
milestone: Dematerialisation strategy drafted by consultants under the digital governance project, reported 2025-09-16
position_end: Under the World Bank-financed digital governance project the finance ministry engaged consultants from May 2024 to design a phased dematerialisation of procurement starting with health and education pilots, stronger oversight by the procurement regulator and a link to the public finance system; no platform is recorded as built

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Ministry-wide planning platform
milestone: An official launch under presidential patronage, digitising a whole ministry
position_end: Human resources, budget, document management, project management, macroeconomic modelling and donor-financing tracking on one platform, plus a central register of government, international and humanitarian projects
note: the vendor pre-financed earlier phases from its own funds with no stated recovery mechanism, and the platform's cost is not stated anywhere; the efficiency figures are projections rather than measurements

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Online tax declaration and payment platform
milestone: Officially launched after adoption and training from January 2025
position_start: Four modules including registration for the unique identification number, run by the tax directorate under a 24-month external service contract, with 301 large and 325 medium firms in scope
position_end: Unchanged; no filing, payment or coverage figure published since launch
sources: 2025-03-25 La Centrafrique lance officiellement e-Tax, sa plateforme de paiement d'impots en ligne
note: nothing on this platform is dated inside the window, and the 2026 estimates carry no line for it

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Operator contribution to accessible public digital services
milestone: Reported 2026-08-26
position_end: an operator account of work to build more accessible and inclusive public digital services

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Public sector digital governance project
milestone: Strategic committee reports 78% activity completion, 18 August 2026
position_start: A US$35m grant approved May 2022 closing December 2026, plus US$6.4m of additional financing appraised May 2025; disbursed US$11.35m, 33%, at April 2025
position_end: The plan revised February 2026 with no disbursement figure later than 33% held, against a closing date of December 2026. Its strategic committee reported the project at 78% activity completion and 54% disbursement with six months to run
note: the funder's own record of procurement performance is candidly poor: planned dates not respected, weak document quality and evaluation committees not held on time

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Treasury single account application
milestone: Modernisation works opened at the central treasury accounting agency
position_start: The public finances plan of June 2025 named six systems and a data centre and no treasury single account application
position_end: An application deployed for the treasury single account, tied to regional banking rules, with the stated object of centralising state balances and eliminating parallel and opaque accounts, and integration with the regional settlement rails
note: no cost, financier, vendor, timetable or number of accounts closed is stated, and the architecture is explicitly regional rather than national

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Unified public-services portal
milestone: A national portal for online government services launched 2026-10-14
position_end: A live single entry point for administrative tasks, request and complaint tracking and access to official documents, with expansion to health, education and tax stated as planned. A national portal for online government services was launched on 2026-10-14, covering driving licences, urban transport subscriptions, criminal-record extracts, nationality certificates, school certificates and medical appointments, with services for businesses, NGOs and financial operators
sources: 2026-10-15-caf-africabusinessinsight-digital-public-services-connectivity-barriers|2025-12-12 Central African Republic Launches Unified Digital Portal for All Public Services
note: the October 2026 launch account does not say whether the portal is the December 2025 entry point relaunched or a new one; no usage, registration or transaction figure is held, and about 12% of the population used the internet at the end of 2025

subject: digital.localgov
name: Bangui street and house addressing programme
milestone: Programme closed 2016, on the francophone mayors' association's account
position_end: Street and house addressing of Bangui was launched on 14 April 2012 with a pilot in the sixth arrondissement over 36 months, under a EUR 1.5m programme of the francophone mayors' association and the European Union that ran from 2011 to 2016 with Douala and Pointe-Noire, setting up addressing units, drawing address plans and numbering doors alongside a census of taxable activities; the revenue gains of over 30% it reports are for the other two cities, and nothing later on Bangui's address file is held

subject: digital.localgov
name: Local-government digital systems
milestone: State of local civil-registry digitisation presented, 18 July 2026
position_end: The civil-registry directorate's own presentation of 18 July 2026 is the clearest dated statement of local digitisation held. Behind it: a development agency's initiative had equipped four prefectural chief towns with technology kits by January 2022; agents were trained on 16 and 17 July 2026 in scanning and securing communal and judicial civil-registry documents under a European project; and one commune's town hall was rehabilitated in April 2026 with technology equipment and staff training for digitising civil-registry documents named as the next step
note: the index returns one source and it is a civil-registration item; nothing on municipal service platforms, commune systems, local revenue or council information systems, in a year when municipal and regional elections were held for the first time in about 36 years

subject: digital.rural
name: First free public Wi-Fi point
milestone: Inaugurated by the President during a north-western tour
position_end: One site, presented as the country's first free public internet access point, with technical support from Russian cooperation
note: a pro-government outlet, and the item doubles as campaign copy for a local legislative candidate; one site with no bandwidth, uptime, user or funding figure

subject: digital.rural
name: Universal service fund school and community connectivity
milestone: Effective implementation listed among the regulator's 2026 priorities at the session presenting a draft budget of FCFA 6.2bn
position_start: The fund created by a 2018 law with a 2019 implementing decree and never operational; its supervising committee's activities launched July 2025
position_end: Effective implementation stated for 2026, financed by a 2% levy on operators' previous-year turnover, with scope covering broadband in schools, health centres, town halls, libraries and post offices
note: no collection figure, fund balance, project award or operator selection is held; the draft budget is the regulator's own, not the fund's endowment

subject: tech.ai
name: Africa AI Governance Index position
milestone: 0.25 of 4, Nascent tier, 51 of 54 states (profile of 7 October 2026)
position_end: 0.25 out of 4 on the Africa AI Governance Index 2026, in the Nascent tier and ranked 51 of 54; the index measures formal governance instruments, not capability

subject: tech.ai
name: AI centre of excellence
milestone: Partnership announced 2025-06-24
position_end: An Indian firm named as partner; no financing or timetable disclosed

subject: tech.ai
name: AI chest X-ray tuberculosis screening at Batangafo hospital
milestone: Installed 2024
position_end: Computer-aided X-ray detection in use at the district hospital for patients over 15, finding 90 of the 203 cases detected in the zone in 2025
note: installed and run by MSF with the health authorities

subject: tech.ai
name: AI model mapping tuberculosis hotspots in Bangui
status: Piloting, research study with the national TB programme
milestone: Study published 2025-04-03
position_end: A predictive model on 100-metre grids built from public data with the national TB programme, flagging hotspots and clinics whose notified rates diverge from predicted positivity
note: built by an international NGO and a Belgian AI firm with the programme; no operational adoption stated

subject: tech.ai
name: AI system deployed in state service delivery
note: no procurement, pilot, model, vendor or deployment is recorded; the only AI-in-government item held is an analytical finding that a presidential land certificate was likely machine-generated

subject: tech.ai
name: Machine learning in subnational price monitoring
milestone: Platform dataset published December 2023
position_end: A development bank's real-time prices platform uses a machine-learning approach to impute missing subnational food-price observations for the country - the clearest instance of machine learning inside a sectoral information system, and it is run outside government

subject: tech.ai
name: Machine translation for the national language
milestone: System published 13 May 2026
position_end: An independently built, non-governmental production translation system for the national language uses vocabulary-augmented prompting over a 581-entry verified lexicon; it is the first artificial-intelligence system for the language the repository holds and it is not the state's

subject: tech.ai
name: MEDICINE AI-assisted fever diagnosis project (Institut Pasteur de Bangui)
milestone: Four-year project presented by the Institut Pasteur de Bangui, 2024-08-01
position_end: A four-year project pairing artificial-intelligence diagnostic aids with rapid tests to help community and health-centre workers tell whether a child's fever is malaria or another cause, starting in Bangui and extending to rural areas; no deployment count is published

subject: tech.ai
name: National AI policy, strategy or regulation
milestone: Minister states the strategy is in elaboration, 21 November 2024
position_end: The digital economy minister stated in November 2024 that the country was in full elaboration of a national artificial-intelligence strategy for 2024 to 2028. No draft, adoption instrument or text has appeared since, and no regulation of artificial intelligence is held
note: the repository holds three sources under this subject and none is a policy instrument; no strategy, decree, bill or regulator mandate appears anywhere

subject: tech.ai
name: National participation in the continental AI research community
milestone: Country represented at the continental gathering, August 2026
position_end: A national representative's own account records the country represented at the continent's main machine-learning gathering and the introduction of a national artificial-intelligence pioneers grouping; no membership, funding or output is published

subject: tech.industry
name: Bitcoin as legal tender
milestone: Parliament amended the April 2022 cryptocurrency law, revoking legal-tender status
position_start: Legal-tender status revoked and acceptance made optional
position_end: Unchanged; no restoration or replacement instrument recorded
note: the country adopted bitcoin as legal tender in April 2022, the first African state to do so; a second held account instead reports a July 2022 suspension, unreconciled

subject: tech.industry
name: ICT sector size, revenue, employment or operator financials
milestone: Operators' first-half 2026 revenue published by the regulator
position_end: The authoritative diagnostic of the digital economy, including its digital-entrepreneurship and production ecosystem, is a development bank assessment of 2020. The clearest instance of domestic production since is a locally built school-management software platform announced by its own developer in October 2025; the regulator's first-half 2026 observatory puts operators' combined revenue above FCFA 41.68bn including tax, 57% from mobile telephony, 36% from internet and 7% from value-added services; no employment or firm count is published
note: the revenue figure is operators' combined turnover as reported to the regulator; no contribution to output, employment count or firm count is held

subject: tech.innovate
name: Presidential meme coin
milestone: Announced by the President; it passed US$900m market capitalisation over the launch weekend and then lost more than 75% of its value
position_start: Traded and collapsed, with its dedicated account suspended almost immediately
position_end: Still the payment rail for the tokenised land concessions; no evidence that its revenues were declared as public income or entered the national budget
note: the fall magnitude is unreconciled between the two held accounts and no first-hand dated report of the launch is held

subject: tech.innovate
name: Startup and SME guarantee fund
milestone: Promised by the finance minister, 2024-07-12
position_end: The finance minister promised a guarantee fund for startups and small firms and a new legal framework for them at the launch of a local startup's marketplace app in July 2024; no fund, capital or text is held since

subject: tech.innovate
name: Startup funding, accelerator cohort or ecosystem figure
milestone: Partnership announced with the country's first incubator, February 2026
position_end: A foundation founded in 2023 describes itself as the country's first incubator dedicated to youth and diaspora entrepreneurs and states a three-year ambition; a partnership with a national initiative was announced in February 2026. No cohort size, funding raised or graduate count is published
note: the entire private-sector technology record is two named firms with no dated transaction

subject: tech.innovate
name: State-sponsored token
milestone: The project announced it would not continue in its original form, the website already offline
position_start: Defunct: 10% of a 210-million token target sold, under EUR 2m raised, and the promised crypto city and island never built
position_end: Unchanged; the status of funds already invested is recorded as unclear
note: launched July 2022 and marketed with passports at US$60,000 and land at US$10,000 held in the token

subject: tech.innovate
name: Tokenised land concessions
milestone: A count of concession sales: 122 plots at a fixed price of about US$314 each
position_start: Opened 2025-06-21 under presidential decree over 1,700 hectares, with no sales figure held
position_end: 122 plots sold for about US$38,308 by November 2025; a flagged expansion to mineral rights is not recorded as happening
note: month precision; the terms are unreconciled between the two accounts, which agree on location but not on pricing

subject: capacity.literacy
name: Digital literacy programme
milestone: Digital records-management training for 15 officials, 16 December 2025
position_end: The measured position is from the national household survey: only 4.1% of men and 1.5% of women hold the information and communication technology competences it tests. Against that, a European mission ran a digital records-management training for 15 participants including staff of one ministry in December 2025 - the scale of the response the repository holds against the scale of the gap
note: the single source carrying the subject is a Wi-Fi inauguration, which is an access point rather than a literacy instrument, and no digital-literacy line appears in three consecutive years of estimates

subject: capacity.training
name: Digital content creation bootcamp
milestone: Second edition held 28-30 May 2026
position_end: A second edition of a digital content creation bootcamp ran in the capital covering blogging, podcast and video production, fact-checking, search optimisation and cybersecurity; no participant count outcome or placement figure is published

subject: capacity.training
name: Digital skills or training programme
milestone: Centre inaugurated 2024-01-15
position_start: No named digital-skills or training programme on file
position_end: A government digital training centre and start-up incubator at the University of Bangui, financed jointly by the European Union and the African Development Bank as a component of the national fibre backbone project and opened alongside the launch of broadband service
note: no enrolment, cohort or budget figure is published for it

subject: capacity.training
name: Digital-governance training partnership with Russia's HSE University
milestone: Signed 9 October 2026 at a forum in Moscow
position_end: A five-year partnership signed on 9 October 2026, to be implemented through a Moscow university: digital-governance training for public servants, joint articles, reports and national case studies, and seminars and expert sessions; no cohort, budget or start date is stated

subject: capacity.training
name: Technology in secondary education
milestone: Ten-year education cooperation framework signed, 19 June 2026
position_start: A country technology profile of May 2023 as the standing statement
position_end: A ten-year framework signed with another state covers nine priority areas including teacher training, pedagogical and curricular engineering, educational technologies and digital learning, school planning and student-support tools, with a briefing on the partner's own education-digitalisation initiatives; it is an intergovernmental commitment, not a classroom implementation

subject: capacity.research
name: Research capacity
milestone: Standing institutional description, undated
position_start: No university, statistics-institute or donor research document on file
position_end: The University of Bangui's Institut supérieur de technologie supplies most of the country's professional engineering graduates in civil, industrial, computing, mining and geological engineering, and runs a master's in engineering sciences
note: the page carries no date, enrolment or research-output figure of its own

subject: capacity.research
name: University multimedia resource centre
milestone: Centre established 2002 on the university's own account
position_end: The national university's multimedia resource centre, established in 2002, is the clearest academic unit with a digital remit the repository holds. A 2026 conference paper by researchers based in the country studies the university's own deployment of a communication platform as a digital-sovereignty case; its full text is behind a paywall and only the abstract is held

subject: include.access
name: Centralised government portal
milestone: Portal launched December 2025
position_end: A unified digital portal was launched in December 2025 as a single point of access to government; no service count, transaction volume or feedback function is described

subject: include.access
name: Digital gender divide
milestone: National review report of September 2024
position_end: The national review report is the most authoritative recent statement of the gender dimension of the digital divide, set against a household survey putting information and communication technology competences at 4.1% of men and 1.5% of women

subject: include.access
name: Disability rights country report
milestone: Country report published in the continental yearbook
position_end: A country report in the continental disability rights yearbook, the repository's only account of the legal and policy position on disability here
note: a 2021 legal survey; it carries no digital accessibility standard, service-design rule or assistive technology provision, which is itself the finding for this repository

subject: include.access
name: Refugee registration and feedback systems
milestone: Operational update for the second quarter of 2026
position_end: 37,389 Sudanese refugees are registered, with card-based registration and a complaints and feedback system recording 535 complaints - the clearest instance the repository holds of a digital feedback channel reaching a displaced population

subject: include.access
name: Telecommunications access for persons with disabilities
milestone: Study-period report covering 2018 to 2021
position_end: An international study-period report states the position on access to telecommunications and technology services for persons with disabilities and others with specific needs; nothing later, and no national measure, obligation or programme, is held

subject: include.divides
name: Satellite retail service affordability
milestone: Roaming on illegally imported kits suspended six weeks after commercial launch
position_start: Did not exist: no licence and no service
position_end: Commercial service since 2026-03-16 at FCFA 33,000 a month plus tax, with a standard kit at FCFA 240,000; the monthly price is about 136% of monthly income per head against an international affordability threshold of 2%
note: the object advanced and affordability did not

subject: data.statistics
name: Fourth general population and housing census (RGPH-4)
milestone: Data cleaning and tabulation retreat, Boali, 2-5 October 2026
position_end: The country's first digital census and first since 2003, launched by decree of 23 March 2022 over 7,591 enumeration areas: enumeration covered 96% of the country, data cleaning ran from May to September 2026, the provisional global results went to the census technical committee on 23 to 25 September 2026 for transmission to the national census commission chaired by the prime minister, and the statistics institute took the data into final cleaning and tabulation at a retreat on 2 to 5 October 2026; financed by the World Bank with UNFPA as technical partner
note: no population figure is public until the national census commission approves the results

subject: data.statistics
name: Harmonised household living-conditions survey
