milestone: Second collection wave launched 2026-10-17, extended to the Fertit region
position_end: About 7,000 households nationwide in three two-month waves, entirely by tablet, with a public commitment to statistical secrecy and aggregates only. The first wave ran from July to September 2026 in six of the seven survey regions, and the second, launched on 17 October 2026, extends collection to the Fertit region of Haute-Kotto, Vakaga and Bamingui-Bangoran, left out of the first for security reasons
note: no results and no publication date; the field period ends around January 2027 and no prior harmonised survey is held

subject: data.statistics
name: Independent measurement of internet penetration
status: Implemented, the regulator's half-yearly market observatory
milestone: First-half 2026 observatory posted by the statistics institute, 2026-09-16
position_start: Not held: every penetration figure traced to one international estimate
position_end: The regulator publishes a half-yearly market observatory from the statistical returns operators must file under its decision of 25 June 2025; the first-half 2026 edition puts internet clients at more than 23% of the population
note: it counts subscriptions from operator returns rather than surveying users

subject: data.statistics
name: National accounts rebasing to 2019 under SCN 2008
milestone: Aide-memoire on the rebasing published by ICASEES 2026-08-07
position_end: National accounts moved from a 2005 base under SCN 1993 to a 2019 base under SCN 2008, drawing on the 2021 national agriculture survey and harmonised household living-conditions survey to widen coverage of agriculture, household consumption, self-build, imputed rent and informal activity; the joint technical and peer review was held 13-18 February 2023 and its aide-memoire released publicly on 2026-08-07 under the World Bank-financed PDNPD project
note: the review it documents was held in 2023; what is new is publication, and no rebased GDP level is stated in the record held

subject: data.statistics
name: Regional statistics harmonisation project (HISWACA-SOP2)
milestone: World Bank supervision mission, 7-8 October 2026
position_end: The World Bank-financed project P180085, coordinated by the statistics institute's director-general, carries the census, the household living-conditions survey, the informal cross-border trade survey and the economic statistics programme; its October 2026 supervision reviewed the 2026 work plan, fiduciary management and the data-dissemination policy
note: no disbursement figure is stated

subject: data.statistics
name: Second national strategy for the development of statistics
milestone: Mid-term evaluation held in Bangui, 7 to 9 October 2026
position_end: The statistics institute's own workshop report is the most current statement that the second strategy is being implemented, through a development-bank-financed regional statistics project. An initiative under way since September 2025 would include, for the first time, forcibly displaced people and those at risk of statelessness - about 447,000 internally displaced and some 62,000 refugees - in national statistics. A mid-term evaluation on 7 to 9 October 2026, financed by UNDP, is to update the strategy with revised indicators and a realigned calendar

subject: data.statistics
name: Seventh multiple indicator cluster survey
milestone: First steering committee session announced for 2026-08-21
position_end: The survey budgeted at 1,942,332,190 FCFA, stated as US$3,531,513, of which about 1.1 billion FCFA was mobilised as at 18 August 2026, with its steering committee convening for the first time
note: about 43 per cent of the budget is unmobilised on the institute own figures; no fieldwork or publication date is stated

subject: data.open
name: EITI implementation
milestone: Low score of 45 in the 2024 Validation; next Validation 1 January 2027
position_end: Scored 45 and suspended by the EITI Board in November 2024, which found no modern government information systems, licence register or beneficial-ownership data; the next Validation starts 1 January 2027

subject: data.open
name: National open government data portal or catalogue
status: Implemented, migration to ODP 2.0 in preparation
milestone: National ODP 2.0 migration plan presented at Libreville, 14 to 18 September 2026
position_end: The statistics institute runs its open data portal on the Open Data Platform and integrated a new open licence on it in June 2026; its microdata archive, running since July 2020, was relaunched with a modernised interface on 29 May 2026. At a CEMAC workshop in Libreville on 14 to 18 September 2026 it presented its national action plan for migrating from ODP 1.0 to ODP 2.0 and demonstrated a locally installed ODP 2.0 test environment loaded with the national accounts for 2013 to 2029
note: the ODP 2.0 environment is a local test installation; no public address or migration date is published

subject: data.open
name: Open education statistics on the statistics institute's site
milestone: Yearbooks 2015-16 to 2024-25 posted, 2026
position_end: The statistics institute ICASEES posts the education ministry's statistical yearbooks from 2015-16 to 2024-25 and key indicators for 2015-2025 as open data under a CC BY 4.0 licence

subject: data.satellite
name: Earth-observation or satellite data
milestone: Crop production projected on satellite-derived data, October 2025
position_end: Three uses are on the record. Ten agriculture ministry experts were trained on space-based data for agriculture and hydrometeorology in 2023 under a development-bank project. The aeronautical meteorological centre at the capital's airport is equipped with satellite reception among its instruments, on a publication effective 7 August 2025. And a continental research body's model, run on remotely sensed geo-biophysical satellite data, projected the country's 2025 cassava production. None of the three is a national programme
note: the index returns zero sources for this subject at any date

subject: geopol.usa
name: Incumbent-operator privatisation and recapitalisation
milestone: The minister met the counterparty's operations vice-president; the government declared the September 2025 memorandum in its operational phase
position_start: Did not exist at the window's start; the memorandum was signed 2025-09-18 at a development round table
position_end: An operational phase declared, with US$150m announced for network modernisation, a data centre and a connectivity ecosystem; definitive agreements, a steering committee and a schedule unfinalised. The prime minister received the United States charge d'affaires together with a vice-president of the prospective technology partner in July 2026
note: the figure is the counterparty's own and appears in no appropriation; the fourth attempted rescue of this operator

subject: geopol.china
name: Vendor four-axis e-government programme
milestone: A working meeting setting four axes: a national data centre, five microwave-relay sites, unified telephony and videoconferencing, and a secure police radio network
position_end: A programme announced with no contract, amount or timetable, and documented in no appropriation
note: these two accounts are the only sources under this subject the repository holds for the country

subject: geopol.eu
name: Civil-status modernisation programme
milestone: A steering committee validated the implementing partner's 2025 activities 2026-02-20
position_end: Externally funded and implemented with the territorial administration ministry, extending from a capital-and-corridor pilot to new communes, with a target of 400,000 birth certificates by 2028 and 2025 activities put at 90% complete
note: a single source, with no financing figure, contract or end date stated

subject: geopol.eu
name: Digital collection of administrative fees
milestone: An implementation workshop 14 to 16 April 2026 with three pilot ministries
position_end: Externally financed at EUR 17.5m over four years, of which EUR 8.5m to one justice component; it targets the small revenues of about twenty ministries and covers issuance of the nationality certificate
note: a single source, and no domestic appropriation for it is on file

subject: geopol.gulf
name: Digital finance and land-banking memorandum
milestone: A memorandum signed at Bangui
position_end: Signed, with no commitment figure, disbursement schedule, timetable or governance arrangement stated
note: the only source under this subject the repository holds; the counterparty is otherwise undocumented

subject: geopol.india
name: India-linked technology activity
milestone: Bilateral brief of 10 April 2026
position_end: India's embassy publishes a dated bilateral brief carrying two standing technology facts: a memorandum of March 2010 establishing an information technology centre of excellence at Bangui, and the pan-African electronic network project's tele-education, tele-medicine and senior-official connectivity build-out in the capital. It is the most current dated statement located that both remain the record of India-funded information and communication technology capacity here. No later project, disbursement or successor instrument is named
note: the index returns zero sources for this relationship at any date
